notes: device = AgentDevice paths (crates/...); gateway = Cloud services/control-plane/modules/runtime-gateway/src/link-gateway.mjs; control = Cloud services/control-plane/modules/devices/src/linked-devices/<file>
A frame is one WebSocket text message holding one JSON object. A data frame has `s` and `m` and no `op`; every other frame has `op` (device crates/hostd-link/src/lib.rs:730-738).
Fields marked '?' are optional. Unknown `op`s are ignored by both ends (device lib.rs:719-796 `_ => Inbound::None`; gateway handles only the ops it names).

protocol.linkVersionSource: device crates/hostd-link/src/lib.rs:50 (VERSION); gateway link-gateway.mjs:352 refuses hello.v != 2 with error DEVICE_OUTDATED
protocol.mcpProtocolVersionSource: device crates/connector-cli/src/host/mod.rs:39 (the host server's default; it echoes the client's protocolVersion, mod.rs:495)

limits.heartbeatSource: device lib.rs:58 (audit_head + load); gateway link-gateway.mjs:180 (ping interval), :263 (no pong/frame for 2 x heartbeat -> close 4408)
limits.relayRequestMaxWaitSource: gateway link-gateway.mjs:39 (MAX_WAIT_MS = 31 min); on expiry the relay sends notifications/cancelled and answers TIMEOUT (:546-551)
limits.eventsMaxSource: gateway link-gateway.mjs:50 (EVENTS_MAX); the device sends at most 200 per batch
limits.requestTtlSource: control protocol.ts:12 (REQUEST_TTL_MS, used for exp at :112)
limits.requestMaxAheadSource: device crates/device-core/src/protocol.rs:16 (60 s + 5 s skew; checked in crates/aggregator/src/sig.rs:150-155)

closeCodes.meaning: first frame not a hello / unsupported version / bad link id
LINK_TAKEN: another device holds this link id
hello timeout, or no pong/frame for 2 heartbeats
replaced by a newer connection of the same link; the device ends (End::Replaced) instead of reconnecting

fields.s: string, MCP session id mcs_[a-f0-9]{32} (issued by the gateway)

fields.gateway: string, the gateway instance id (not read by the device)
fields.owner?: object {v:1, kid, link, account, sig}, the control plane's signed owner statement

frames.notes: DEVICE_REVOKED ends the link (revoked); DEVICE_OUTDATED, LINK_DISABLED, GATEWAY_NOT_ALLOWED, SANDBOX_REQUIRED end it (refused); any other code reconnects

frames.source: device lib.rs:599,744-750; gateway link-gateway.mjs:461-463 (device→gateway: pending requests of that session answered SESSION_CLOSED), :498 (gateway→device on DELETE of the session)

frames.when: right after welcome and every heartbeat

fields.link: object, LinkInfo with the same id

fields.code: PORT_CLOSED | PORT_DIAL_FAILED | PORT_BUSY | PORT_SANDBOXED | PORT_NOT_IN_SANDBOX (device names); the gateway also accepts PORT_FOLDER_MODE, PORT_OUTSIDE_LINK

fields.instances: array of {instance: string, epoch: integer, job: string}

frames.source: device lib.rs:327-329,602; gateway link-gateway.mjs:400-413 (forwards to Control /internal/devices/links/instances)
gateway link-gateway.mjs:406; device lib.rs:765-784 (entries without job and instance strings are dropped)

fields.items: array of {seq, id, space, instance?, event | table, payload, key?, cause?, at}

fields.seq: integer, highest seq the platform is done with

helloLink.source: device crates/hostd-link/src/lib.rs:74-145 (LinkInfo::to_json); gateway cleans it in link-gateway.mjs cleanInfo/cleanCapacity

fields.id:
string lnk_<32 hex>: PC = sha256('agentrouter-link/v1
<device id>
<canonical first folder>')[:32 hex] (device lib.rs:150-158); cloud = sha256('agentrouter-link/v1
cloud:<sandbox id>
<folder>') (control service.ts:214-216)
fields.folder: string, display name of the first folder
fields.folders: string[] ≤ 32, real absolute paths, first is home
fields.capacity: object|null {cores, physical_cores, memory_mb, disk_mb, gpus[{vendor,name,memory_mb}], environments, limits?}
fields.resources?: object, only when measured (never on a cloud host)
fields.software?: array, only after the first discovery

signing.canonicalJson: object keys sorted by UTF-16 code units, no whitespace, numbers and strings as JSON.stringify writes them (device crates/device-core/src/protocol.rs:57-150; control protocol.ts:33-37)

strings.status: Control only: hostd no longer verifies it (the signed action set was removed, device protocol.rs:1-3); used on the v1 device channel (device-gateway.mjs)

strings.purpose: link id derivation (sha256, not a signature)

fields.kid: first 16 hex of sha256(raw control public key)
fields.digest: sha256 hex of canonical JSON of params without _meta

otherMetaKeys.agentrouter.top/timeoutMs: read by hostd as the call's limit (default 600 000 ms, clamped 1 s..30 min; crates/aggregator/src/lib.rs:60-69,1954-1959); Control does not send it
otherMetaKeys.note: _meta keys other than agentrouter.top/sig are not signed (the digest excludes _meta); hostd lists title, turn, timeoutMs as unsigned display/pacing keys (crates/aggregator/src/lib.rs:66-69)

signedTopLevelParams.agentrouter.top/account: initialize: the launching account (control protocol.ts:124; device sig.rs:49)
signedTopLevelParams.agentrouter.top/recipe: initialize, when a recipe is known (control protocol.ts:132); hostd accepts and does not read it

linkSignature.checkOrder: version, kid, signature, link, digest, expiry (exp > now and exp <= now + 65000), nonce format, session non-empty, replay (device crates/aggregator/src/sig.rs:112-171)
linkSignature.failure: JSON-RPC error code -32001 with data.code SIGNATURE_INVALID | REQUEST_EXPIRED | REPLAYED | WRONG_LINK

cloudHostToken.boundTo: one sandbox and one link id; refused on the v1 device channel and for any other link

legacyDeviceChannel.status: served by the gateway's device hub (device-gateway.mjs:3); hostd never dials it
